target_state: Structured intake with validated fields, assumptions, and user confirmation.
current_state: Six-step browser UI accepts a free-text brief and examples.
main_gap: No structured confirmation of extracted requirements; no runtime proof.

target_state: Versioned capability registry separates runtime, provider, model, and supported adapter semantics.
current_state: Hard-coded runtime/provider/model catalogs are selectable.
main_gap: Catalog freshness is not verified and selection has no operational provider connection.

target_state: Schema-versioned canonical manifest with stable IDs and migrations.
current_state: Typed AgentManifest is the central renderer input.
main_gap: No runtime schema validation, migrations, or canonical serialization.

target_state: Loss-aware extraction that preserves explicit user requirements and requires confirmation for inferred fields.
current_state: Keyword and fragment rules infer domain, autonomy, stack, capabilities, and prohibitions.
main_gap: User-specific inputs, outputs, success criteria, roles, and workflows are largely replaced by domain presets.
cap_reason: Source-inspected only; heuristic false positives expected.

target_state: Evidence-linked markers propagated into every claim and validation result.
current_state: MISSING, ASSUMPTION, SOURCE_NEEDED, UNVERIFIED, BLOCKER are represented and rendered.
main_gap: Markers are not tied to claim IDs or source evidence and do not gate release consistently.

target_state: Per-agent identity, scope, authority, constraints, and role boundaries.
current_state: SOUL.md is generated with purpose, values, capabilities, prohibitions, tone, and escalation.
main_gap: Only one agent identity exists; no role inheritance or conflict resolution.

target_state: Executable lifecycle contract with preconditions, checkpoints, completion and abort gates.
current_state: HEARTBEAT.md provides before/during/after checks and abort conditions.
main_gap: Advisory Markdown only; no machine-enforced state transitions.

target_state: Machine-readable tool contracts mapped to runtime permissions, hooks, and approval policies.
current_state: TOOLS.md and GUARDRAILS.md are rendered from ToolSpec and prohibitions.
main_gap: Permissions are descriptive only and are not compiled into runtime enforcement configs.

target_state: Canonical input plus injected build metadata yields byte-for-byte reproducible core artifacts.
current_state: Pure render functions generate files from a manifest.
main_gap: new Date() timestamps and ZIP timestamps make same-input outputs differ; the UI claim is too strong.

target_state: Dependency-aware package planner with required/optional modules and transparent consequences.
current_state: Blueprints are proposed, locked, selectable, and re-rendered after changes.
main_gap: Dependency model is handwritten and not derived from actual Markdown AST or adapter contract.

target_state: Officially sourced, versioned adapters with fixture tests for each client and clear parity limits.
current_state: Adapters exist for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and portable Markdown.
main_gap: Windsurf path is not aligned with current documented mechanisms; Claude imports are rendered as literal backticked paths rather than @ imports; nested scopes are absent.

target_state: Parse rendered Markdown, resolve actual links/imports, detect cycles, missing targets, and adapter-invalid references.
current_state: Checks compare blueprint reference arrays against selected paths.
main_gap: Reference metadata diverges from rendered content, creating false negatives and false positives.

target_state: Explicit rule engine plus optional model-based review, both evidence-labeled and independently testable.
current_state: Heuristic checks detect autonomy, tools, privacy, success criteria, escalation, and thin briefs.
main_gap: Called semantic but implemented as deterministic regex/manifest checks; no semantic model or corpus eval.

target_state: Every finding has reversible patch, diff preview, audit trail, revalidation, and rollback.
current_state: Selected findings can mutate the manifest or add a file and trigger full re-render.
main_gap: No diff preview, rollback, persisted audit trail, or comprehensive repair coverage.

target_state: Fail-closed release decision based on schema, tests, adapter compatibility, unresolved blockers, and eval thresholds.
current_state: A simple 100-minus-penalties score and textual blockers are shown.
main_gap: UNVERIFIED runtime behavior and notes can still coexist with a 100 score and downloadable package.

target_state: Tested archive export with checksums, manifest, path safety, size limits, and round-trip verification.
current_state: Dependency-free ZIP STORE writer preserves nested paths in the full archive.
main_gap: No automated archive round-trip, checksum manifest, ZIP64/limit handling, or corruption test.

target_state: Download preserves required directory paths or clearly instructs placement.
current_state: Each rendered file can be downloaded separately.
main_gap: saveText strips directory components, so .cursor and .github files lose their installation path.

target_state: Local-first operation with explicit data-flow proof, CSP, no telemetry by default, and privacy tests.
current_state: No fetch, WebSocket, local storage, or backend calls were found in source; generation is browser-local.
main_gap: No runtime network inspection, CSP, privacy test, or dependency supply-chain proof.

target_state: Graph of agent nodes, roles, authority, dependencies, shared policies, and routing rules.
current_state: Product name says network, but the canonical model contains one AgentManifest only.
main_gap: Core target capability is absent.
cap_reason: Only naming and single-agent files exist.

target_state: Task schema with owner agent, inputs, outputs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and status transitions.
current_state: No task entity or assignment model exists.
main_gap: Core target capability is absent.

target_state: Typed handoff contracts, context package limits, responsibility transfer, and failure escalation.
current_state: Generic escalation text exists.
main_gap: No inter-agent handoff entity, routing, or contract.

target_state: JSON Schema or equivalent runtime validation, schema versioning, migrations, and invalid-input diagnostics.
current_state: TypeScript interfaces exist and documentation calls extraction schema-validated.
main_gap: No schema file or runtime validation call exists.

target_state: Fixtures and automated assertions for extraction, rendering, adapters, safety, and model-behavior evals.
current_state: EVALUATION.md contains manual cases with UNVERIFIED status.
main_gap: No test runner, fixtures, thresholds, or result persistence.

target_state: Untrusted brief isolation, Markdown/fence escaping, instruction provenance, and policy conflict detection.
current_state: General prohibitions and uncertainty markers are generated.
main_gap: User text can cross formatting/instruction boundaries; no sanitizer, AST, or injection tests.

target_state: Local projects, autosave, import, version history, manifest diff, rollback, and deterministic rebuild.
current_state: React state is session-only; exports can be downloaded.
main_gap: No persistence or round-trip import.
cap_reason: Export is the only related capability.

target_state: Unit, property, integration, archive round-trip, adapter fixtures, E2E, accessibility, and CI release gates.
current_state: No test files, test script, lint script, typecheck script, or CI configuration were found.
main_gap: Entire quality automation layer is absent.

target_state: Each adapter stores official source, verified date, supported semantics, limits, and deprecation state.
current_state: Runtime behavior and model names are hard-coded in catalog.ts.
main_gap: No provenance, freshness date, compatibility test, or update workflow.

target_state: Client error reporting with opt-in telemetry, release diagnostics, support bundle, and privacy controls.
current_state: No observability or support diagnostics exist.
main_gap: Absent.

target_state: README, architecture decisions, contracts, limits, runbook, contribution and release documentation.
current_state: A focused feature-slice document explains pipeline, layers, markers, limitations, and extension points.
main_gap: No root README, ADRs, deployment/runbook, or compatibility source map.

target_state: WCAG-oriented keyboard, screen-reader, responsive, reduced-motion, and automated accessibility proof.
current_state: Labels, buttons, aria attributes, responsive classes, and reduced-motion timing branch are visible in source.
main_gap: No browser/E2E or accessibility audit; timed progress remains misleading.
